derived.causal_summary: The Relic sickness is a TweakDB status effect, not a story system: each of BaseStatusEffect.JohnnySickness{Low,Medium,Heavy} carries only a fullscreen VFX, a camera-breathing animation, a fullscreen SFX and a stamina-regeneration penalty, applied by eleven quest call sites. Vanilla therefore cannot kill V with it; the 5d-to-1d countdown ladder is Nexus mod 25974's addition keyed off the sickness_on fact. Emptying the payload at the record neutralises all call sites at once with no quest-graph edits. REDmod cannot override an existing TweakDB record -- its tweak compiler rejects a redeclared group -- so the change is applied to the shipped sources under tools/redmod/tweaks and recompiled with redMod.exe deploy, alongside a marker mod because deploy is a no-op with zero mods deployed.
